question: Amoebiasis or amoebic diarrhea is a common parasitic infection of the intestine, caused by _______ group of amoeba.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Entamoeba**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amoebiasis or amoebic diarrhoea **is a common parasitic infection of the intestine, caused by** the Entamoeba group of amoeba.**
 
• **Amebiasis **is an intestinal (bowel) illness caused by a microscopic (tiny) parasite called **Entamoeba histolytica,** which is spread through **human feces. **
 
• **Entamoeba **is a genus of Amoebozoa found as internal parasites or commensals of animals. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Amoeba is a single-celled organisms belonging to the group protozoa.
 
• Amoeba has no definite shape, unlike other organisms.
 
• It keeps on changing its shape. various projections of varying lengths keep protruding out of its body. These are called pseudopodia (pseudo: false; podia: feet).
 
• These pseudopodia perform various functions like movement and locomotion, capturing prey (food), etc.
